integrity: The proof supplies a self-contained characterization and count. An independent finite-field closure script exhaustively checks nineteen small configurations, not the full infinite theorem. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
limitations: The theorem concerns unital generation in the radical-square-zero truncation; the critical limit assumes a simple loopless directed quiver sequence and a convergent normalized tuple parameter. Publication priority is provisional.
title: Random generation of radical-square-zero quiver algebras: exact probabilities and a density-corrected birthday law
